name: Mirador Laguna Calluqueo (drive-up viewpoint, Cochrane)
time: 1 h walk, 3 h driving return from Cochrane
terrain: Good gravel road, short walk to viewpoint; no glacier trail
caution: private-land gate beyond the mirador; do not continue to the glacier front (Río Pedregoso ford, exposed traverse)
why: Free view of Monte San Lorenzo and the Calluqueo glacier without a tour

name: Laguna Esmeralda (Cochrane, short stop)
terrain: Lake shore and picnic site; T1
caution: no trail details found; stop only, not a hike day
why: Free blue lake on the road to the Calluqueo valley

name: Refugio Toni Röhrer, Monte San Lorenzo (one night)
time: 2-3 h each way, 2.5 h drive from Cochrane
terrain: Trail with a stream crossing; poor last stretch of road; stop below Paso del Comedor
caution: private-land, ford; road condition and ford for cars unconfirmed; no 2026 information
why: Almost no visitors; the Chilean side of Monte San Lorenzo
